verdict.rationale: Docs confirm private-by-default notes (not shared until a link is sent or added to a team folder) and a basic private vs. team-space folder model, plus workspace-level admin API keys for Business/Enterprise. However, there is no evidence of granular per-link/per-folder permission controls or an admin dashboard/audit log showing what has been shared across the workspace. Missing for 10: granular link/folder permission settings, admin visibility/audit trail into shared content, independent corroboration of admin controls.
